component.name: Avatar
component.description: Circular user or entity avatar with fallback initials and optional indicator.

slots.name: root
slots.description: Avatar frame that controls size, shape, image, fallback, and badge placement.

slots.name: image
slots.description: Loaded avatar image rendered inside the frame.

slots.name: fallback
slots.description: Text fallback shown while the image is unavailable or failed.

slots.name: fallbackIcon
slots.description: Icon fallback shown when no image or text fallback is available.

slots.name: badge
slots.description: Status or indicator badge anchored to the avatar frame.

slots.name: group
slots.description: Container that lays out multiple avatars as an overlapping group.

slots.name: groupItem
slots.description: Individual avatar wrapper used when rendering grouped avatars.

slots.name: groupCount
slots.description: Count indicator shown when a group has more avatars than the visible limit.

own.name: items
own.description: Array of items to render in a group.

own.name: max
own.description: Maximum number of avatars to show when in a group.

props.name: alt
props.description: Accessible alt text for the avatar.

props.name: fallback
props.description: Icon name to show as fallback.

props.name: onStatusChange
props.description: Callback when the loading status of the avatar changes.

props.name: src
props.description: Source URL for the avatar image.

props.name: text
props.description: Initial text to show if image fails or is missing.
